title: Bug 640098: Make Table Information Cache refresh resilient to duplicate table numbers
summary: The Table Information Cache refresh now aggregates metrics when duplicate table numbers are encountered instead of failing with a duplicate-key error. This makes the Data Administrator page's refresh action resilient to orphaned or renamed SQL tables.
key_points: Resolves a failure in the Table Information Cache refresh when platform virtual table contains duplicate table numbers with different names
Aggregates numeric metrics (record count, size, index size) across multiple cache rows with the same company and table number
Prevents NavCSideDuplicateKeyException that interrupted the entire refresh operation
